findings.issue: False kanji fact: the prose groups 遠/戻/越/逃 as "todos com o radical 辶", but 戻 has no 辶 at all (it is 戸 + 大, radical 戸/とだれ) and 越 is 走 + 戉 (radical 走/そうにょう). Only 遠 and 逃 carry 辶.
findings.current: De movimento (todos com o radical 辶): 遠 "distante, longe" ... 戻 "voltar, retornar" ... 越 "ultrapassar" ... 逃 "fugir"
findings.suggested: De movimento: 遠 "distante" e 逃 "fugir" trazem o radical 辶; já 戻 "voltar" usa 戸 (porta) e 越 "ultrapassar" usa 走 (correr).

findings.issue: Inconsistent/incorrect mora rendering in the pronunciation note: after describing っ as a silent pause, the transcription doubles the consonant ("tto"), implying an extra beat. The parallel note in lesson 03 correctly writes "ji-(pausa)-to" for じっと. ジェット has 3 moras: ジェ/ッ/ト.
findings.current: ジェット tem o っ (uma pausa silenciosa): je-(pausa)-tto.
findings.suggested: ジェット tem o っ (uma pausa silenciosa): je-(pausa)-to.

findings.issue: False kanji fact: the four "movement" kanji are claimed to all carry the 辶 radical, but 戻 has 戸 (door) and 越 has 走 (run). Only 遠 and 逃 use 辶.
findings.current: De movimento (todos com o radical 辶): 遠 "distante, longe" ... 戻 "voltar, retornar" ... 越 "ultrapassar, atravessar" ... 逃 "fugir, escapar"
findings.suggested: De movimento: 遠 e 逃 trazem o radical 辶; já 戻 tem 戸 (porta) e 越 tem 走 (correr).

findings.issue: Word error: "contrai a realidade" (contracts) instead of "contraria a realidade" (contradicts) — the body itself says "a pose deliberada que contraria a realidade".
findings.current: a encenação deliberada que contrai a realidade
findings.suggested: a encenação deliberada que contraria a realidade

findings.issue: Romanization double-marks the geminate: the silent pause is spelled out and then the consonant is doubled too, implying an extra beat. The sibling lesson writes じっと as "ji-(pausa)-to".
findings.current: ジェット tem o っ (uma pausa silenciosa): je-(pausa)-tto
findings.suggested: ジェット tem o っ (uma pausa silenciosa): je-(pausa)-to
